budget_items.topic: Kiku liquor license annual fee and proration
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Annual fee of $1,450 runs on the calendar year with under a quarter remaining; the Town Manager calculated the prorated fee at $362.50.
budget_items.quote: the chair noted that the annual fee of $1,450 runs on the calendar year and that less than one quarter of the year remained.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Member McQuaid supported pursuing an RFP at no cost to the town.
budget_items.quote: member mcquaid supported pursuing an rfp at no cost to the town but said another curb cut on massachusetts avenue was not ideal.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town maintains more than 450 outfalls and over 1,000 catch basins, with infrastructure estimated at more than $70 million.
budget_items.quote: with infrastructure estimated at more than $70 million, and much of it is over 50 years old.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fines for noncompliance with the federal MS4 permit range from $5,000 to $50,000 per day.
budget_items.quote: the ms4 permit's fines for noncompliance range from $5,000 to $50,000 per day.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: DPW Director reported annual stormwater spending of roughly $100,000 against an estimated $480,000 per year needed for compliance.
budget_items.quote: annual stormwater spending has been roughly $100,000, against an estimated $480,000 per year needed for compliance.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Current estimate is $85 per ERU (equivalent residential unit of 4,200 square feet), not to exceed $100 for the first three years; rate not finalized by the SWTF.
budget_items.quote: current estimate is $85 per eru, not to exceed $100 for the first three years, with a flat rate for single- and two-family homes.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A stormwater utility would carry about 4.5% overhead and offer credits and abatements of up to 50% for maintained on-site controls.
budget_items.quote: a stormwater utility would carry about 4.5% overhead, credits and abatements of up to 50% for maintained on-site controls

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Average single-family property would pay about $109 a year under the operating budget alternative, versus $85 under the utility.
budget_items.quote: under the operating budget alternative, an average single-family property would contribute approximately $109 annually towards stormwater maintenance/ms4 compliance, versus $85 under the utility.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Clerk McLeod cited prior appropriations of roughly $80,000 for stormwater utility work in voicing concern about the advisory question.
budget_items.quote: citing prior appropriations of roughly $80,000 for stormwater utility work

budget_items.what_was_recorded: SWTF member John Beale said the central issue was the $460,000 funding need (the minutes print $480,000 elsewhere for the annual need).
budget_items.quote: the central issue was the $460,000 funding need

budget_items.topic: Track and field design and engineering article
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Superintendent requested a $195,830 article for design and bid documents only (Gale Associates proposal), not construction; placed on warrant as Article 5.
budget_items.quote: superintendent dr. jodi fortuna requested placement of a $195,830 article for professional engineering and related services

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 6 would draw on the fund, which holds state funds of $350,000 received with Tri-Town construction, with $138,000 spent in 2012.
budget_items.quote: state funds of $350,000 received with the construction of tri-town, with $138,000 spent in 2012

budget_items.topic: Zoning Incentive Stabilization Fund appropriation rule

budget_items.quote: she stated that any appropriation requires a two-thirds town meeting vote

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bids for a roughly $500,000 roof replacement are due October 28th.
budget_items.quote: bids for the roughly $500,000 public safety building roof replacement are due october 28th.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Retiree renewals are 2.43% for Medex and 1.79% for Managed Blue; double-digit increases likely for active plans.
budget_items.quote: retiree renewals are 2.43% for medex plans and 1.79% for managed blue.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Free cash certification is uncertain for the November 17th Special Town Meeting.
